ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum curling up; 3-day crossed up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low) (investor cycle week 14 · failed · daily cycle day 22).
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)

entry.text: Trend intact — hold; add on dips toward the 10-day average.

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 22 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 22 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 14 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: late — the bigger cycle is getting old
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 14 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 晚期——更大的周期已趋于老化
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked mid-way — a neutral, balanced structure.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在中段见顶——结构中性、均衡。

ladder.next_zh: 关注 10 日均线与周期天数。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量开始上翘；3 日线向上交叉；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）（投资者周期第 14 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期第 22 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上
ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal just triggered today (fresh cross from NEARING A LOW). Signal strength: moderate (score +55/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自接近低点翻转）。 信号强度：中等（评分 +55/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱买入形态（+15）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
